name: AgeInPlace-Synth v1
description: "AgeInPlace-Synth is a fully synthetic, openly licensed dataset of ambient smart-home sensor streams from 360 simulated older adults (65\u201395 years) who live alone. Each resident is followed for 180 days (148,211,299 sensor events in total). Every stream comes with a minute-accurate ground-truth timeline of activities and health-relevant events: 152 falls in 86 residents (13 long lies of 60 minutes or more, 37 followed by hospital stays), 121 nocturia-escalation episodes, 87 gradual functional-decline trajectories across four domains, 84 benign routine changes that act as confounders, and 400 labelled sensor faults. Behaviour is calibrated to published population statistics (American Time Use Survey 2025, CDC fall surveillance, normative gait speed, nocturia prevalence; all 18 time-use targets met within 7%, faller shares exact by cell) and the sensor layer to real CASAS homes of older adults: on 28 held-out CASAS homes not used for fitting, 9 of 10 day-level metrics, including event density, fall within the range that separates two samples of real homes. Every parameter is labelled as published, derived, fitted or assumed.
